Example text, to be replaced by the committee.

The SACSA Easter Tournament is about friendship as much as competition. Everyone taking part (players, coaches, officials and supporters) is expected to:

- respect opponents, officials and organisers
- accept the decisions of referees and umpires
- keep the venues clean and follow venue rules
- look out for younger players

Serious misconduct can lead to removal from the tournament.

Example text, to be replaced by the committee.

- Teams must be ready on court 10 minutes before their game.
- A team not ready 15 minutes after the scheduled start forfeits the game.
- Team managers must check scores with the scorer before leaving the court.
- Protests go to the sport convenor within 30 minutes of the game ending.
